# January meeting (sample)

## Where you stand

Your accounts are worth about $143,291. Over the past year your holdings returned 11.9%, against 12.7% for the S&P 500. (Sample letter: every number is fictional.)

## What I recommend, in order

**1. Rebalance inside the IRA first (no tax).** Trades there cost nothing in tax.

**2. Trim Luma Software in the brokerage account.** It is well above my value and is your largest single stock there.

**3. Add to the total market fund with new money.** It keeps you diversified at low cost.

**4. Keep three months of expenses in cash.** Your emergency fund sits outside these accounts.

## Next meeting

Next month, after the quarterly reports.
